description: Comprehensive methodology, source metadata, discrepancy log, and data limitations for the KIIFB Accountability Dashboard.

sources.name: Report of the Expert Committee to Review the Resource Mobilisation and Functioning of KIIFB
sources.author: Dr. K.M. Abraham (Chairman) & Expert Committee
sources.format: Official PDF (80.3 MB, 2400 lines markdown extraction)
sources.coverage: Audited financial tables (Chapters III, IV, VI), 1,240 portfolio projects, district outlays, and 8 recommendations.

counting_units.definition: A single administrative sanction issued by the KIIFB Board or Executive Committee. A single sanction may represent an individual civil work (e.g. flyover) or an umbrella cluster covering dozens or hundreds of institutions (e.g. 'Centres of Excellence in 141 High Schools').
An individual physical institution (school, hospital block, lab) with a unique departmental code, physical location, and physical handover certificate.

discrepancies.title: Commercial Bank Loans Rounding (Table 3.4)
discrepancies.description: Sum of the 10 commercial bank loans equals ₹6,083.21 Crore, whereas the printed table total is ₹6,083.22 Crore.
discrepancies.mathematical_reconciliation: Bank of Baroda (₹480.00 Cr) + Canara Bank (₹1,500.00 Cr) + Union Bank (₹600.00 Cr) + SBI (₹1,850.00 Cr) + PNB (₹500.00 Cr) + Indian Bank (₹400.00 Cr) + Federal Bank (₹383.21 Cr) + Indian Overseas Bank (₹200.00 Cr) + South Indian Bank (₹100.00 Cr) + UCO Bank (₹70.00 Cr) = ₹6,083.21 Cr. Difference = +0.01 Cr due to rounding in Federal Bank tranche.
discrepancies.dashboard_treatment: Recorded printed total ₹6,083.22 Cr with documented 0.01 Cr rounding note in test suite and UI.

discrepancies.title: Land Acquisition Repaid Amount Discrepancy (Table 4.5)
discrepancies.description: Sum of repaid amounts across the 7 land acquisition projects is ₹1,401.07 Crore, whereas the printed table total is ₹1,386.64 Crore.
discrepancies.mathematical_reconciliation: Bio 360 Life Science Park (₹84.02 Cr) + Petrochemical & Pharma Park (₹554.65 Cr) + Global City KBIC (₹0.00 Cr) + Industrial Park HNL (₹0.00 Cr) + Kochi-Bengaluru Industrial Corridor (₹337.04 Cr) + Industrial Infrastructure Land Acquisition (₹425.36 Cr) + NHAI Land Acquisition (₹0.00 Cr) = ₹1,401.07 Cr. Discrepancy = 14.43 Cr under-reported in printed total.
discrepancies.dashboard_treatment: Preserved both the printed total (₹1,386.64 Cr) and calculated sum (₹1,401.07 Cr) with explicit provenance alert in unit tests.

discrepancies.title: Missing Geographic District Data in Public Portal (DS010)
discrepancies.description: All 1,408 project sanctions on KIIFB's live public status portal omit district location attributes (district: null for 100% of records).
discrepancies.mathematical_reconciliation: 1,408 out of 2,377 unified records (59.2%) lack district tags in the primary web table.
discrepancies.dashboard_treatment: Cross-referenced with KITE Sametham database (969 geo-tagged schools) and Committee Report Table 4.2 aggregate district outlays.

discrepancies.title: SC/ST Development Statutory Allocation Deficit
discrepancies.description: SC/ST Development received only ₹182 Crore (0.24% of infrastructure outlay) and ₹87 Crore released (0.28%), severely below Kerala's 12.64% SCSP/TSP statutory benchmark.
discrepancies.mathematical_reconciliation: Statutory benchmark = 12.64% of ₹77,151 Cr = ₹9,751.89 Cr. Actual approved = ₹182.00 Cr (Deficit of ₹9,569.89 Cr).
discrepancies.dashboard_treatment: Highlighted with dedicated alert in Sector Distribution table and Public Value Distributional dimension.

discrepancies.title: Kannur Industrial Land Pool Concentration
discrepancies.description: Kannur accounts for ₹12,257.50 Crore out of ₹16,420.73 Crore in industrial land acquisition — 74.65% of the state's total industrial land pool.
discrepancies.mathematical_reconciliation: ₹12,257.50 Cr / ₹16,420.73 Cr = 74.65% of industrial land pool (52.86% of total land acquisition pool including NH-66).
discrepancies.dashboard_treatment: Mapped in interactive district visualizer with Chapter IV audit note on lack of comparative industrial appraisal.

discrepancies.title: Unmodelled Ex-Post Socio-Economic Returns
discrepancies.description: Neither KIIFB nor the Committee report measured macroeconomic or ex-post social rates of return, treating social infrastructure purely as uncompensated fiscal drain.
discrepancies.mathematical_reconciliation: Only 8% of portfolio projects possess documented ex-post outcome metrics; 92% constitutes an unmodelled data gap.
discrepancies.dashboard_treatment: Categorized explicitly as data_gap rather than zero in the 5-dimensional public value evaluation.

limitations.title: As-Of Date Divergence
limitations.description: Committee report audited tables reflect data as of June 30, 2026. Live project status portal data reflects updates up to October 2026. Figures are segregated and clearly tagged with their respective as-of dates.

limitations.title: Absence of Vintage Aging Data
limitations.description: KIIFB did not furnish vintage or year-wise sanction breakdown to the Committee (Para 4.2), preventing historical duration modeling between project sanction and first drawal.

limitations.title: Sub Judice Status of Article 293
limitations.description: Constitutional questions regarding Article 293 and off-budget borrowing are pending before a 5-judge Constitution Bench of the Supreme Court of India in Original Suit No. 1 of 2024. The dashboard maintains strict distinction between advisory audit opinion and final judicial determinations.

limitations.title: Non-Enactment of Advisory Recommendations
limitations.description: Committee restructuring recommendations have no self-executing force of law until enacted by the Legislative Assembly or notified through executive Government Orders.
